description: Defines a base class for testing HTTP/2 decoding, including helper functions and mechanisms for segmenting input buffers and validating decoding results.

classes.name: RandomDecoderTest
classes.description: A base class for testing decoding of HTTP/2 and HPACK encodings with buffer segmentation and validation utilities.

methods.name: ToStringPiece
methods.description: Converts an array of data into an absl::string_view.

methods.name: CorruptEnum
methods.description: Overwrites an enum value with a random value, possibly invalid.

methods.name: RandomDecoderTest
methods.description: Constructor for the base test class.

methods.name: StartDecoding
methods.description: Pure virtual method to start decoding, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: ResumeDecoding
methods.description: Pure virtual method to resume decoding, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: StopDecodeOnDone
methods.description: Returns whether decoding should stop when kDecodeDone is reached.

methods.name: DecodeSegments
methods.description: Decodes input buffer in segments based on a size selector.

methods.name: DecodeSegmentsAndValidate
methods.description: Decodes in segments and validates the result.

methods.name: SelectRemaining
methods.description: Returns a segment size that consumes all remaining input.

methods.name: SelectOne
methods.description: Returns a segment size of one byte.

methods.name: SelectZeroAndOne
methods.description: Returns a segment size that alternates between zero and one.

methods.name: SelectRandom
methods.description: Returns a segment size chosen randomly.

methods.name: DecodeAndValidateSeveralWays
methods.description: Decodes multiple times with different segmentations and validates consistency.

methods.name: ToValidator
methods.description: Converts various validator types into a standard Validator function.

methods.name: ValidateDoneAndEmpty
methods.description: Validator that checks if decoding is done and buffer is empty.

methods.name: ValidateDoneAndOffset
methods.description: Validator that checks if decoding is done and buffer offset matches expected.
